name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands carrying the box to the exit and requires picking it up again if it falls, but the machine only rewards reaching the exit with the box. To fix, add a reward for reaching the exit with the box, and keep the existing reward for reaching the exit. Also, add a rule for picking up the box if it falls. The task also requires the siren to be silent, but the task and machine do not address this requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands to carry the box to the exit, but the given clause makes it happen only if the box falls and is picked up again. The task requires the box to be carried throughout, so add a hard Existence(holding_box) on every step where the agent is carrying the box, and keep the RespondedExistence clause that makes it happen again after a fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses are correct and match the task requirements. The first clause, 'Existence(holding_box)', correctly captures the requirement to carry the box to the exit. The second clause, 'RespondedExistence(box_fell, holding_box)', correctly captures the requirement to pick up the box again on the very next move if it falls.

texts: Carry the box to the exit
If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u1
(u0, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, box_fell&holding_box) -> u1
(u2, holding_box) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !box_fell&holding_box, u1) -> 11
(u0, box_fell&holding_box, u1) -> 11
(u2, holding_box, u1) -> 11
